contracts.question: One number per question, and can we trust it?
contracts.yaml:
product:     executive_kpis_monthly
department:  Executive
owner:       chief-data-officer@example.com
engineer:    vim@example.com
question:    "One number per question, and can we trust it?"
definition:  >
  AUA = account value at month end (opening value plus cumulative flows).
  Net Flows uses the Finance definition. Active clients = clients holding
  at least one account at month end.
grain:       [month]

freshness:
  column:    month
  max_lag_days: 35

columns:
  - name:  aua_gbp
    tests: [not_null, {range: {min: 0}}]
  - name:  net_flows_gbp
    tests: [not_null]
  - name:  active_clients
    tests: [not_null, {range: {min: 0}}]

reconcile_to_product:
  product:   finance_net_flows_daily     # same number in every deck: exec flows = finance flows
  measure:   net_flows_gbp
  tolerance_gbp: 0.01

access:
  read:      [grp_exec_mi, grp_board_pack]
change:
  breaking:  owner_approval

results.sql: SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly WHERE aua_gbp IS NULL
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly WHERE aua_gbp < 0
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly WHERE net_flows_gbp IS NULL
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly WHERE active_clients IS NULL
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly WHERE active_clients < 0
SELECT month, count(*) AS n FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly GROUP BY month HAVING count(*) > 1

results.check: freshness: month within 35 day(s) of the run
results.sql: SELECT max(month) AS latest FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly HAVING max(month) < DATE'2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 35 DAYS

WITH f AS (SELECT trunc(trade_date, 'MM') AS month, round(sum(net_flows_gbp), 2) AS finance FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily GROUP BY 1) SELECT e.month, e.net_flows_gbp, f.finance FROM nexus_gold.executive_kpis_monthly e JOIN f USING (month) WHERE abs(e.net_flows_gbp - f.finance) > 0.01

contracts.question: What came in and went out today, and does it agree with the ledger?
contracts.yaml:
product:     finance_net_flows_daily
department:  Finance
owner:       finance-reporting-lead@example.com  # signs off the definition
engineer:    vim@example.com                     # owns the pipeline
question:    "What came in and went out today, and does it agree with the ledger?"
definition:  >
  Net Flows = sum(amount_gbp) over contributions (positive), withdrawals and
  fees (negative). Switches between funds and income are excluded.
grain:       [legal_entity, wrapper_code, trade_date]

freshness:
  column:    trade_date
  max_lag_days: 1          # ready by 06:30 Europe/London, business days

columns:
  - name:  legal_entity
    tests: [not_null, {accepted_values: [affluent, hnw]}]
  - name:  wrapper_code
    tests: [not_null, {accepted_values: [ISA, JISA, PENSION, GIA, BOND]}]
  - name:  net_flows_gbp
    tests: [not_null]
  - name:  gross_inflows_gbp
    tests: [{range: {min: 0}}]

reconcile:
  against:   finance_ledger
  match_on:  [trade_date, wrapper_code]
  measure:   net_flows_gbp
  ledger_measure: ledger_net_flows_gbp
  tolerance_gbp: 0.01

access:
  read:      [grp_finance, grp_exec_mi]
change:
  breaking:  owner_approval   # blast radius posted on the PR

results.sql: SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily WHERE legal_entity IS NULL
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily WHERE legal_entity NOT IN ('affluent', 'hnw')
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily WHERE wrapper_code IS NULL
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily WHERE wrapper_code NOT IN ('ISA', 'JISA', 'PENSION', 'GIA', 'BOND')
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily WHERE net_flows_gbp IS NULL
SELECT * FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily WHERE gross_inflows_gbp < 0
SELECT legal_entity, wrapper_code, trade_date, count(*) AS n FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily GROUP BY legal_entity, wrapper_code, trade_date HAVING count(*) > 1

results.check: freshness: trade_date within 1 day(s) of the run
results.sql: SELECT max(trade_date) AS latest FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily HAVING max(trade_date) < DATE'2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 1 DAYS

WITH p AS (SELECT trade_date, wrapper_code, round(sum(net_flows_gbp), 2) AS platform FROM nexus_gold.finance_net_flows_daily GROUP BY trade_date, wrapper_code) SELECT trade_date, wrapper_code, platform, l.ledger_net_flows_gbp AS ledger, round(platform - l.ledger_net_flows_gbp, 2) AS difference FROM p FULL JOIN nexus_silver.finance_ledger l USING (trade_date, wrapper_code) WHERE abs(coalesce(platform, 0) - coalesce(l.ledger_net_flows_gbp, 0)) > 0.01

contracts.question: Where are we losing people, and is it getting worse?
contracts.yaml:
product:     hr_workforce_monthly
department:  HR
owner:       people-analytics-lead@example.com
engineer:    vim@example.com
question:    "Where are we losing people, and is it getting worse?"
definition:  >
  Headcount = colleagues employed at month end. Leavers (12m) = colleagues
  whose last day fell in the trailing 12 months. Attrition = leavers / average headcount.
grain:       [month, function]

freshness:
  column:    month
  max_lag_days: 35

columns:
  - name:  function
    tests: [not_null, {accepted_values: [Advice, Investments, Operations, Technology, Distribution]}]
  - name:  headcount
    tests: [not_null, {range: {min: 0}}]
  - name:  attrition_rate_12m
    tests: [{range: {min: 0, max: 1}}]

privacy:
  min_cell_size: {column: leavers_12m, size: 5}   # small groups are suppressed, never published
  no_colleague_level_columns: true

access:
  read:      [grp_hr, grp_exec_mi]   # aggregates only; records stay with HR
change:
  breaking:  owner_approval

quality.source:
def split_by_contract(spark: SparkSession, contract: dict) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Clean rows continue; failing rows go to quarantine with the failed rule names attached."""
    rules = contract["quality"]["rules"]
    raw = spark.table(table("bronze", contract["target"]["table"])).withColumn("trade_date", F.to_date("trade_date"))
    passed = " AND ".join(f"({e})" for e in rules.values())
    valid = raw.filter(passed).filter("op <> 'D'")
    quarantine = (raw.filter(f"NOT ({passed})")
                  .withColumn("_failed_rules", F.array_compact(F.array(*[
                      F.when(~F.expr(e), F.lit(n)) for n, e in rules.items()])))
                  .withColumn("_quarantined_at", F.current_timestamp()))
    write(valid, "silver", "platform_transaction")
    write(quarantine, "silver", "platform_transaction_quarantine")
    return valid.count(), quarantine.count()

scd2.source:
def build_dim_fund_share_class(spark: SparkSession) -> None:
    """SCD2 from the charge history: a repriced share class never rewrites a past period."""
    charges = spark.table(table("bronze", "fund_charge")).withColumn("effective_from", F.to_date("effective_from"))
    w = Window.partitionBy("isin").orderBy("effective_from")
    dim = (charges.join(spark.table(table("bronze", "fund")), "isin")
           .withColumn("valid_from", F.col("effective_from"))
           .withColumn("valid_to", F.coalesce(F.lead("effective_from").over(w), F.lit("9999-12-31").cast("date")))
           .withColumn("is_current", F.col("valid_to") == F.lit("9999-12-31").cast("date"))
           .withColumn("fund_sk", F.xxhash64("isin", "valid_from"))
           .select("fund_sk", F.col("isin").alias("fund_nk"), "fund_name", "asset_class",
                   "ongoing_charge_pct", "risk_rating", "valid_from", "valid_to", "is_current"))
    write(dim, "silver", "dim_fund_share_class")

fact.source:
def build_fct_platform_transaction(spark: SparkSession) -> None:
    fact_name = table("gold", "fct_platform_transaction")
    if spark.catalog.tableExists(fact_name):
        hwm = spark.table(fact_name).agg(F.max("_ingested_at")).first()[0] or datetime(1900, 1, 1)
    else:
        hwm = datetime(1900, 1, 1)                           # first run = full load

    src = (spark.table(table("silver", "platform_transaction"))
           .filter(F.col("_ingested_at") > F.lit(hwm) - F.expr(LOOKBACK)))
    fund = spark.table(table("silver", "dim_fund_share_class"))
    acct = spark.table(table("silver", "account"))
    client = spark.table(table("silver", "dim_client"))

    # point in time: the share-class version in force on the trade date
    fact = (src.alias("s")
            .join(fund.alias("f"), (F.col("f.fund_nk") == F.col("s.isin"))
                  & (F.col("s.trade_date") >= F.col("f.valid_from"))
                  & (F.col("s.trade_date") < F.col("f.valid_to")), "left")
            .join(acct.alias("a"), "account_id")
            .join(client.alias("c"), "client_id")
            .select(F.xxhash64("s.transaction_id").alias("transaction_sk"), "s.transaction_id",
                    "f.fund_sk", "f.ongoing_charge_pct", "s.account_id", "c.client_sk", "s.wrapper_code",
                    "c.legal_entity", "c.channel", "s.trade_date", "s.transaction_type", "s.amount_gbp",
                    "s._ingested_at"))

    if not spark.catalog.tableExists(fact_name):
        fact.limit(0).write.format("delta").saveAsTable(fact_name)
    (DeltaTable.forName(spark, fact_name).alias("t")
       .merge(fact.alias("u"), "t.transaction_sk = u.transaction_sk")
       .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
       .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
       .execute())

product.source:
def finance_net_flows_daily(spark: SparkSession) -> None:
    fct = spark.table(table("gold", "fct_platform_transaction")).filter(F.col("transaction_type").isin(FLOW_TYPES))
    write(fct.groupBy("legal_entity", "wrapper_code", "trade_date").agg(
        F.round(F.sum(F.when(F.col("amount_gbp") > 0, F.col("amount_gbp")).otherwise(0)), 2).alias("gross_inflows_gbp"),
        F.round(-F.sum(F.when(F.col("amount_gbp") < 0, F.col("amount_gbp")).otherwise(0)), 2).alias("gross_outflows_gbp"),
        F.round(F.sum("amount_gbp"), 2).alias("net_flows_gbp")), "gold", "finance_net_flows_daily")

compile.source:
def compile_checks(c: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Each check is a SQL query that returns the failing rows. Zero rows = pass."""
    t = table("gold", c["product"])
    checks = []
    for col in c.get("columns", []):
        for test in col.get("tests", []):
            name, arg = (test, None) if isinstance(test, str) else next(iter(test.items()))
            if name == "not_null":
                sql = f"SELECT * FROM {t} WHERE {col['name']} IS NULL"
            elif name == "accepted_values":
                sql = f"SELECT * FROM {t} WHERE {col['name']} NOT IN ({', '.join(_q(v) for v in arg)})"
            elif name == "range":
                cond = [f"{col['name']} < {arg['min']}"] if "min" in arg else []
                cond += [f"{col['name']} > {arg['max']}"] if "max" in arg else []
                sql = f"SELECT * FROM {t} WHERE {' OR '.join(cond)}"
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"unknown test {name} in {c['_path']}")
            checks.append({"check": f"{name}: {col['name']}", "kind": "column", "sql": sql})

    g = ", ".join(c["grain"])
    checks.append({"check": f"unique grain: {g}", "kind": "grain",
                   "sql": f"SELECT {g}, count(*) AS n FROM {t} GROUP BY {g} HAVING count(*) > 1"})

    f = c["freshness"]
    checks.append({"check": f"freshness: {f['column']} within {f['max_lag_days']} day(s) of the run",
                   "kind": "freshness",
                   "sql": f"SELECT max({f['column']}) AS latest FROM {t} "
                          f"HAVING max({f['column']}) < DATE'2026-09-30' - INTERVAL {f['max_lag_days']} DAYS"})

    if r := c.get("reconcile"):
        on = ", ".join(r["match_on"])
        checks.append({"check": f"reconcile to {r['against']} within £{r['tolerance_gbp']}", "kind": "reconcile",
                       "sql": f"WITH p AS (SELECT {on}, round(sum({r['measure']}), 2) AS platform FROM {t} GROUP BY {on}) "
                              f"SELECT {on}, platform, l.{r['ledger_measure']} AS ledger, "
                              f"round(platform - l.{r['ledger_measure']}, 2) AS difference "
                              f"FROM p FULL JOIN {table('silver', r['against'])} l USING ({on}) "
                              f"WHERE abs(coalesce(platform, 0) - coalesce(l.{r['ledger_measure']}, 0)) > {r['tolerance_gbp']}"})

    if r := c.get("reconcile_to_product"):
        other = table("gold", r["product"])
        checks.append({"check": f"same number as {r['product']}", "kind": "reconcile",
                       "sql": f"WITH f AS (SELECT trunc(trade_date, 'MM') AS month, round(sum({r['measure']}), 2) AS finance "
                              f"FROM {other} GROUP BY 1) SELECT e.month, e.{r['measure']}, f.finance FROM {t} e "
                              f"JOIN f USING (month) WHERE abs(e.{r['measure']} - f.finance) > {r['tolerance_gbp']}"})

    if p := c.get("privacy"):
        if m := p.get("min_cell_size"):
            checks.append({"check": f"no published {m['column']} below {m['size']}", "kind": "privacy",
                           "sql": f"SELECT * FROM {t} WHERE {m['column']} < {m['size']}"})
        if p.get("no_client_level_columns") or p.get("no_colleague_level_columns"):
            checks.append({"check": "no person-level columns in the product", "kind": "privacy_columns",
                           "forbidden": ["client_id", "email", "national_insurance_no", "colleague_id", "full_name"],
                           "sql": f"DESCRIBE TABLE {t}  -- fails if any person-level column is present"})
    return checks
